## Session Overview

In this session a panel of your mentors will discuss how they built their professional identity and practice.

## Before we Meet

- Watch our **October pre-session video** on professional identity formation before the panel.

- Prepare and submit two questions for the panelists — ones you genuinely can't answer yourself.

## When we Meet

Held over **Zoom** (link posted in Canvas).

### Learn

Panel discussion with our mentors.

### Reflect

Q&A with the panel. Listen for the trade-offs each panelist has made. Bring questions. Leave with one cue for your own professional identity and practice.

## After we Meet

- Initiate the mid-fall check-in with your mentor (schedule it now, so it happens this month).

- Accomplish your October goal.

**Course milestone:** Professional Development Plan (Oct).
